title: The Research Excellence Postdoctoral Fellows Program
institution: University of Toronto, Temerty Faculty of Medicine
about: University of Toronto Temerty Medicine programme for lab-nominated postdoctoral fellows; fellowships run 1 April 2027 to 31 March 2028. Applications opened 6 November 2026 and close 31 January 2027, with results in April.
requirements: Nominated by a lab; only one nominee per lab is selected from the 2027 competition

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: field "Health and biomedical research" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Nominated by a lab" (postdoctoral research role) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
